name: AeroBloom
summary: AeroBloom is a single-player first-person action game set in a coastal city. Players throw bouncing discs to destroy the environment block by block, earn credits, buy upgrades, and unlock powers. The city includes parkour challenges, areas to explore, a tornado flight ability, and nighttime fireworks. Casino Brisa offers blackjack, roulette, and other minigames using currency earned in the game, with no real-money gambling.
